_readme: Hand-written overrides for the Facebook feed. scripts/sync-facebook.mjs reads
this file and merges it into assets/data/news.json on every run, so anything
here survives the sync — use it for English / Japanese copy, custom titles,
and curated posts that are not Facebook posts at all.
Key = the Facebook post id (visible in assets/data/news.json).
Add title_en / title_ja / message_en / message_ja / excerpt_en / excerpt_ja
for translations; set "hidden": true to drop a post; set "pinned": true to
keep a post even after it scrolls past the feed limit.
Curated posts (not from Facebook) just need their own id plus title_zh /
